description: Template and JSON Schema for a signed mandate produced by scripts/sign_proof.ts. The signer starts from the `example` template below, fills in issuer, issuanceDate, exp, jti, and attaches `proof`. All other fields are caller-defined and optional.

example.task: Describe the authorized task here before signing.

aud.description: Optional audience (verifier / service) the mandate is intended for.

exp.description: Expiration as Unix epoch seconds. Filled in at signing time.

issuanceDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the mandate was signed. Filled in at signing time.

issuer.description: DID of the mandate issuer (the agent's did:key). Filled in at signing time.

jti.description: Unique mandate ID (UUID) for replay protection. Filled in at signing time.

proof.description: Detached proof block attached after signing.

sub.description: Optional DID of the subject the mandate is about.

task.description: Optional human-readable description of the authorized task.

title: Sovereign Identity Mandate
